limitations: Component manifests have temporary locks, not the production root closure.
Wasm checks are compile evidence, not browser execution.
Non-GNU Linux ABI, nightly wasm atomics and getrandom extern_impl are retained but not executed.
parking_lot_core deadlock_detection was already unsupported (missing optional dependency integration); no current profile selects it.
Tokio docsrs retains pre-existing warning set; strict broken-link mode remains baseline-failing.
